name: @kite/desktop
description: Kite desktop shell (Electron): opens the deployed Kite web app in a locked-down window and adds native features via window.kiteDesktop.
author: Paramount Intelligence

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --external:electron --outdir=dist && esbuild src/accurate/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --outfile=dist/accurate-worker.js && esbuild src/recordings/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --outfile=dist/recording-worker.js && node scripts/stage-native.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm electron:install && pnpm build && playwright test
scripts.test:manual: pnpm electron:install && pnpm build && playwright test -c playwright.manual.config.ts
scripts.dist:win: pnpm electron:install && pnpm build && node scripts/stage-stt-model.mjs && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.mac:prepare: pnpm electron:install && pnpm build && node scripts/stage-native.mjs --mac-universal && node scripts/stage-stt-model.mjs
scripts.dist:store: pnpm electron:install && pnpm build && node scripts/stage-stt-model.mjs && electron-builder --win appx --publish never
